description: Two record types told apart by a signed zoned digit resolved under the ebcdic convention -- F5 for one and C5 for the other -- read under ASCII with the ascii-zone-37 convention, which spells an unsigned and a positive 5 with one byte. The literals re-express to one byte string, so the consumer re-checks overlap and refuses the pair before any record is read.
source: docs/ir/SPEC.md, "What cannot be re-expressed is refused before any record is read", overlap is re-checked, not inherited
